sections.heading: Accreditation Statement
sections.body: The Emory University School of Medicine is accredited by the Accreditation Council for Continuing Medical Education (ACCME) to provide continuing medical education for physicians.

sections.heading: Credit Designation Statement
sections.body: The Emory University School of Medicine designates this Regularly Scheduled Series (RSS) CME Activity for 1 credit per session for a maximum of 1.0 AMA PRA Category 1 Credits™. Physicians should claim only the credit commensurate with the extent of their participation in the activity.
